blocks.text: How do I model with trigonometric functions?

blocks.md:
- Various real-life situations can be modelled using trigonometric functions
- You need to be able to interpret the equations used in the model
- If you need to identify maximum or minimum values of a formula, remember the bounds of the **sin** and **cos** functions: ![Model Trig Illustr 1, A Level & AS Maths: Pure revision notes](assets/91c2f8eded8e-5-9-1-model-trig-illustr-1.png)

  - **-1 ≤ sin *****x *****≤ 1**
  - **-1 ≤ cos *****x *****≤ 1**
- You may need to **simplify trigonometric expressions** to make the behaviour of an equation clearer

blocks.alt: Model Trig Illustr 2, A Level & AS Maths: Pure revision notes

blocks.md:
- You may also need to discuss the **period** of an equation

  - The period is often indicated by ***T***
  - For a periodic function in ***x*** like **sin** or **cos**, the **period** is how much ***x*** has to change by for the function to go through one complete cycle

blocks.alt: Model Trig Illustr 3_period graph, A Level & AS Maths: Pure revision notes
